'''Bolan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] active during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He had an eccentric personality and knew how to speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] due to chips he implanted in his own brain. He was a leader of a techno-criminal group of Niktos known as [[the Circle]], which was employed by [[Darth Zash]] before being imprisoned on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] by the Galactic Republic. Bolan and the Circle were freed during the [[Invasion of Belsavis]] around [[3641 BBY]], yet remained on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] due to the technological opportunities on the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] world. The [[Force walk|Force-walker]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] approached them later during the war where the Nikto assisted the ill [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Lord of the Sith]] find the [[Mother Machine]] in exchange for the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] planting communication links between Belsavis and the wider galaxy in order to further the criminal organization's influence.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
